comment: Overall impression: The draft is technically thorough and well-structured, covering the architecture landscape comprehensively. However, it reads primarily from the perspective of national governments and large institutions, and would benefit from stronger guidance on how the architecture applies at the last mile, where community health workers, offline environments, and resource-constrained field operations are the reality for the majority of the populations this infrastructure is meant to serve.
